foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

source_capture_contract.limitation: The retrieval interface supplied normalized page text, not original HTTP response bytes or headers. Source URLs, publisher timestamps, page timestamps, line-qualified evidence references and the values transcribed are retained. No raw-page hash is claimed.
source_capture_contract.event_time_rule: Publisher event/update times are kept distinct from this run's retrieval reference time.

spot_context.scope: Perpetual futures summary; displayed with a 15-minute delay.
limitations: Mark price is not a synchronized spot midpoint.
Aggregator's exchange set and contract normalization may differ from other providers.
Aggregator spot field; not a direct exchange event-time receipt.
Snapshot is 34 minutes older than the retrieval reference and 34 minutes older than the TradRadar page update.
This is mixed spot/perpetual depth, not spot-only consolidated depth.
Provider-derived samples were not archived as raw exchange order-book payloads.
Displayed orders can be placed or pulled; walls are not guaranteed support or resistance.
No synchronized executable-cost, fee, latency or market-impact calculation is available.
Liquidations are marked as at least because exchanges publish only part of the live liquidation stream.
Long/short is an account ratio, not notional exposure.
The 15-minute reporting delay applies.

alpha_finance.model_scope: All-exchange aggregate; liquidation clusters are modelled from open interest and standard leverage tiers.
limitations: Modelled liquidation clusters are not observed resting orders.
The page does not expose a reconciled contract-by-contract venue universe in this snapshot.
Real liquidation prices depend on position size, margin mode and maintenance margin.

reconciliation.explanation: The two snapshots are 34 minutes apart, report different venue/contract scopes, and do not expose matching aggregation definitions. Preserve both values; do not average or select one as ground truth.

xrp_insights.method: Per-fund day-over-day change in issuer-reported XRP holdings, with dollar values calculated using the dataset's XRP reference price.
important_scope_notes: GXRP flow is excluded across the history because a four-week automated-capture gap would collapse accumulated holdings changes into one misleading day; GXRP holdings remain in totals.
XRPR includes exposure through another XRP exchange-traded product, so its reported XRP exposure is not necessarily direct spot custody.
BITW is a multi-asset index fund; its XRP sleeve can change through index rebalancing.
The aggregate is not a direct issuer-published cash creation/redemption total.
The dataset notes that reconstructed rows can use third-party daily flow estimates; the Nov 6 row is identified as the latest settled row in the current metadata.
limitations: Underlying holdings originate from issuer pages, but the daily flow series is calculated by XRP Insights.
The dataset is not a complete direct cash-flow ledger.
No original HTTP response bytes or per-issuer source payloads were retained in this browser capture.

excluded_funds.GXRP: Not included in daily flow because automated issuer reads encounter a bot challenge; latest quarterly SEC filing holdings are shown separately.
excluded_funds.XRPR: Not counted because its 1940 Act structure includes exposure through other exchange-traded products and its direct-holdings file is not a complete measure of total exposure.

issuer_file_observations.XRP: Nov 6 issuer file observed Nov 7 13:13 UTC.
issuer_file_observations.XRPC: Nov 6 issuer file observed Nov 7 05:07–05:12 UTC.
issuer_file_observations.TOXR: Nov 6 issuer file observed Nov 7 12:01 UTC.
issuer_file_observations.XRPZ: Latest row remained Nov 5; the Nov 6 file had not been observed by the page's 13:23 UTC update.

date_anomaly.observation: The page header says an issuer file dated Nov 9, 2026 was read at 05:12 UTC on Nov 7, 2026, which is future-dated relative to the read time. Per-fund rows separately report Nov 6 files and the 3/4 partial status.
date_anomaly.treatment: Do not use the future-dated header as a valid issuer event time. Preserve it as a page consistency defect; use the explicit per-fund publication observations only as the page reports them.

limitations: Nov 6 total is explicitly partial, not a complete four-fund total.
The per-fund issuer publication times are page-reported; original issuer response bytes were not captured here.
XRP Insights and CryptoKeyhole both depend on issuer holdings, so their results are not independent economic flow sources.
The page reports a five-fund flow series but does not publish fund holdings, AUM or daily issuer receipts.
The visible methodology does not identify the upstream source or provide enough detail to reproduce the Nov 6 zero from issuer holdings.
Treat the $0 print as that provider's reported value, not as independently verified zero net creations/redemptions.

conclusions: XRP Insights reports a negative Nov 6 holdings-derived change across its wider six-spot-plus-BITW universe, with GXRP flow excluded.
CryptoKeyhole reports a more negative Nov 6 partial change from three of four tracked daily-reporting funds, entirely attributable to XRPC in its displayed table.
Alpha Finance reports zero across five funds but does not expose holdings, AUM, issuer receipts or a reproducible source lineage on the page.
The three figures cannot be averaged or treated as independent confirmations.

hypotheses.statement: There was a genuine XRPC redemption/holdings reduction on Nov 6.
hypotheses.support: CryptoKeyhole's issuer-file-derived table reports -752,048 XRP for XRPC; XRP Insights' wider holdings-derived total is also negative.

hypotheses.statement: The complete six-spot-plus-BITW Nov 6 net flow was exactly -663,043 XRP.
hypotheses.support: XRP Insights publishes a settled Nov 6 row and describes its holdings-delta methodology.
hypotheses.counterevidence: GXRP flow is excluded; XRPR and BITW have special exposure/rebalancing characteristics; source issuer bytes were not captured in this run.

hypotheses.statement: The full five-fund Nov 6 flow was exactly zero.
hypotheses.counterevidence: No fund holdings, AUM, issuer receipts or reproducible upstream source lineage are exposed on the page; this conflicts with the other holdings-derived observations.

hypotheses.statement: The apparent disagreement is mostly universe and publication-cutoff mismatch rather than a true economic contradiction.
hypotheses.support: CryptoKeyhole explicitly marks Nov 6 as 3/4 partial; XRP Insights uses a wider universe; Alpha Finance uses a five-fund flow-only series.
hypotheses.counterevidence: The provider-specific underlying rows are not all available for a full same-fund reconciliation.

source_independence.xrp_insights_vs_cryptokeyhole: Different collectors and fund coverage, but both depend on the same issuer holdings source material; not independent economic flow confirmation.
source_independence.alpha_finance: Separate dashboard, but its upstream flow lineage is not disclosed on the captured page; independence cannot be verified.
source_independence.primary_issuer_confirmation: No complete issuer-primary daily cash creation/redemption ledger was captured.

reasons: Spot, derivatives and order-book sources have different timestamps and aggregation scopes.
The order-book snapshot mixes Binance spot and OKX perpetual depth.
Open-interest providers disagree by USD 850M and expose different venue coverage.
ETF flow sources use different universes, methods and completeness; one Nov 6 total is explicitly partial.
No complete primary issuer cash-flow ledger or original page bytes were captured.
